verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents first-party connections to Stripe (payments) and to Ramp and Brex (spend/banking-adjacent accounts), with transactions auto-categorized and revenue reconciled once connected, so payments and some financial-account activity flow into the ledger. Payroll integrations are never evidenced, direct bank-feed connections are not explicitly documented, and the integration claims are marketing-level rather than setup docs. Missing for 10: any payroll integration, explicit bank-account feed connection docs, depth on sync behavior and frequency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: 3 min to reconcile revenue When you connect Stripe with Puzzle
2x faster to close books When you connect Ramp with Puzzle
98% transactions categorized When you connect Brex with Puzzle
Puzzle customers who fully onboard and connect supported integrations can reduce the time required to complete their monthly close by 50% or more
